My Background

I'm a BBA Marketing graduate from Sam Houston State University (May 2026) and a four-year NCAA Division I tennis athlete — competing at No. 1 singles. That combination shaped how I think: disciplined, competitive, and always tuned to what moves people.


From managing social calendars for brand activations across Indian cities at Social Sailor, to executing influencer campaigns and writing client scripts — I bring both strategic thinking and real execution. Certified in UX Design by Google and Marketing Management by IIM Bengaluru.


I speak four languages — English, Tamil, Kannada, Hindi. Based in Bangalore. Open to opportunities.

007 — My Story
Between Bangalore and Texas. Sport taught me everything I know about pressure, strategy, and showing up — every single day.

I grew up in Bangalore and spent four years competing as a Division I tennis player at Sam Houston State University. Managing a full academic load alongside high-performance athletics built the kind of discipline and adaptability that no classroom can fully teach.

Back in Bangalore, I put that into practice at Social Sailor — managing brand activations across Indian cities, coordinating influencers, and writing campaign scripts. Certified by Google and IIM, I bring both the strategic foundation and the real-world execution. Marketing, to me, is a sport you never stop practicing.
